rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent compact stepped mass in all four views, with no visible cross-view collisions and a consistent dominant form. The upper body is legible and the silhouette is not merely code-minimum stair-stepping; it has a capacity-bearing, terraced profile that fits the neighborhood-living brief reasonably well. The main weakness is the ground relation: the blue frontage edge is acknowledged only weakly by the visible undercut/notch, so the public threshold could be more emphatic and more clearly aligned to access. The form does not look like the wrong typology, and the section logic supports a mixed neighborhood building better than a pure sealed block, but the void is still modest compared with the strongest references. Overall, this is program-fit with room to sharpen the frontage void and anchor the base more cleanly.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More pavilion-like and sculptural than this candidate; do not imitate the roof curvature directly.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part massing with a central void and a lifted/bridged upper element can create a legible public threshold for neighborhood-scale programs.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much larger and more distributed than the candidate; avoid over-fragmenting the form.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A campus-like arrangement can organize public open space while keeping massing compact and legible.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This reference is more civic and rectilinear; candidate should stay more compact and step-based.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A shallow court/cut combined with an overhanging upper volume can activate the ground edge without dissolving the main mass.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is more vertically compact and stair-stepped; don't force an elongated bar.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Long horizontal spread with a central void and a folded/terraced roof can suit mixed neighborhood use.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Its multi-wing campus logic is broader than the candidate; use terrace continuity, not dispersion.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced sections and connecting elements can preserve a dominant mass while generating public circulation and open space.

warnings: Parcel containment could not be independently verified from the provided raster beyond the visible green boundary, so the hard gate is assessed only by apparent containment in-view.
The access response is present but underpowered relative to the clearly marked frontage edge; this is the main area for improvement.
